frame_definition: origin at the Earth-Moon barycentre, +x toward the Moon, rotating counterclockwise; km = normalized coordinate x length_scale_km; t = days after TLI
seed_choice: the first main seed, fixed before any catalog was inspected (no seed selection); the 16-seed summaries are the evidence, one seed is an example
survival_definition: s_i = fraction of the draws feasible without correction, or with a commanded MCC |dv| <= B that is feasible after its execution under the primary Gates set (D25); stored robustness rows, not recomputed

d1.name: log10_perilune_altitude_km
d1.definition: d1 = log10(h_p / km), h_p the closest perilune altitude

d2.name: return_time_days
d2.definition: d2 = t_ret, the return-shell crossing time after TLI (days)

grid.binning: k = floor(bins (d - min) / (max - min)) clipped to [0, bins - 1] (protocol 5.5)
grid.reachable_definition: G (protocol 5.3): cells with a feasible propagation in the ground truth, sources (a)-(d); (d) added none at 10 x 10

simplification.tolerance: min(abs_tolerance_km, rel_tolerance * distance to the nearer primary centre), point-to-segment distance in the synodic frame
simplification.input: accepted solver steps, each refined into `substeps` dense-output samples
simplification.cap_rule: if more than max_points are kept, the tolerance is scaled by 1.5 until they fit

fan_simplification.tolerance: min(abs_tolerance_km, rel_tolerance * distance to the nearer primary centre), point-to-segment distance in the synodic frame
fan_simplification.input: accepted solver steps, each refined into `substeps` dense-output samples
fan_simplification.cap_rule: if more than max_points are kept, the tolerance is scaled by 1.5 until they fit
